needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the right side of the road.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and stalls

needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing wide roads.
